title: Classes are plans
summary: A class is a plan for making similar objects. Each object made from it is called an instance.
introduction: A class is a plan for making similar objects. Each object made from it is called an instance. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question
